recipe.name: alertzero-hunt-agent-picker-scoped
test: ! git grep -n -- '\.\.\.\[truncated\]' -- 'x-pack/**' 'src/**' || (echo 'FAIL: committed truncation artifact' && false)

! git grep -nE '\.(skip|only)\(|xit\(|xdescribe\(' -- 'x-pack/solutions/security/plugins/alertzero/public/pages/watches/**' 'x-pack/solutions/security/packages/kbn-alertzero-common/impl/**' || (echo 'FAIL: skipped test committed' && false)
recipe.notes: Gates run on m1max, where this worktree is bootstrapped; it is intentionally not bootstrapped locally. .hermes/verify-on-m1max.sh refuses to run unless the changed files are byte-identical on both hosts, so drift fails instead of producing a false green.
